# KitchFlow

KitchFlow (KitchFlow – Kitchen Ops) is kitchen operations software for restaurants, cafés and food-service teams.

Official website:
https://kitchflowapp.com

Main capabilities:
- Inventory management
- Food waste tracking
- Staff scheduling
- Kitchen task management
- Supplier management

Supported platform:
- iOS (App Store)

Official App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kitchflow-kitchen-ops/id6762667252

Important pages:
- https://kitchflowapp.com/
- https://kitchflowapp.com/about
- https://kitchflowapp.com/restaurant-inventory-management
- https://kitchflowapp.com/restaurant-food-waste-management
- https://kitchflowapp.com/restaurant-staff-scheduling
- https://kitchflowapp.com/kitchen-task-management
- https://kitchflowapp.com/restaurant-supplier-management
- https://kitchflowapp.com/blog
